name: OpenClaw All CLI
description: Run local coding CLIs as OpenClaw models. Cursor first.

providerAuthChoices.choiceHint: Reuse the login of the local Cursor CLI
Keep a key in the plugin config; only cursor-agent sees it

cursor-cli.label: OAC / Cursor-CLI
cursor-cli.help: Settings for the cursor-cli/<model> models, served by the local cursor-agent.

cursor-cli.command.label: cursor-agent command
cursor-cli.command.help: Path or name of the Cursor CLI. Set it when the Gateway's PATH does not include cursor-agent.

cursor-cli.env.label: Environment for cursor-agent
cursor-cli.env.help: Variables given to the cursor-agent process only, such as CURSOR_API_KEY. Values are treated as secrets.

cursor-cli.env.*.label: Value
cursor-cli.env.*.help: Hidden as a secret in the form and in config output.

cursor-cli.maxConcurrentTurns.label: Max concurrent turns
cursor-cli.maxConcurrentTurns.help: Turns that run at once (1 to 64, default 4). More wait in order for a free slot.

cursor-cli.maxProcesses.label: Max cursor-agent processes
cursor-cli.maxProcesses.help: cursor-agent processes alive at once, idle ones included (1 to 64, default 8, at least the concurrent turns). At the cap the least recently used idle process is closed.
